استعطفنا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَفْنَا (istaʕṭafnā) /is.taʕ.tˤaf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# اُسْتُعْطِفْنَا (ustuʕṭifnā) /us.tuʕ.tˤif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
